audit_disclaimer: Livreur is a mobile-app surface. No web pages exist for the driver. This audit validates the API contract + admin-side cash-session cockpit. Full pickup/delivery user journey requires the React Native client (out of scope for this codebase).

findings.title: Livreur self-service cash-session API not implemented
findings.evidence_quote: The livreur self-service surface (`/api/frontend/delivery-boy-shift/*`) is a separate controller (Wave 6b-1.3b) — not part of this BUILD-1 scope.
findings.impact: In production a livreur cannot start a shift without an admin physically opening their session. Breaks the BUILD-5 cash-trail model where the driver collects cash door-to-door and reconciles at end of shift.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.2 — add Wave 6b-1.3b FrontendDeliveryBoyCashSessionController scoped to Auth::user() with same NF525 audit + variance gates.

findings.title: Ten hardcoded English `abort(403, 'Access denied: ...')` reach livreur response body
findings.impact: Inconsistent UX in French-only product. lang/fr/all.php has full coverage for other paths (invalid_status_transition L266, kiosk_machine_inactive L219) but not these.
findings.recommendation: Add lang/fr/all.php keys `access_denied_order_not_yours`, `access_denied_outside_branch` etc. Replace string literals with trans('all.message.access_denied_*').

findings.title: SimpleDeliveryBoyOrderResource.order_address emitted as null silently for DELIVERY orders without Address relation
findings.impact: Mobile-app driver UI sees blank address card with no actionable signal. No fail-fast or fallback to user.address.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) fail-fast at OrderService boundary if a DELIVERY order lacks an address, or (b) add `address_required_for_delivery: true` flag to the resource so the mobile app can show a blocker UI.

findings.title: User.status legacy value 1 silently 401s Sanctum bearer despite valid token — Status::ACTIVE=5 mismatch
findings.impact: Any user seeded by legacy fixtures (status=1) is locked out until manually UPDATE users SET status=5. Confusing diagnostics — middleware returns generic Unauthenticated. at token-resolution layer rather than User account inactive at the explicit check.
findings.recommendation: Add migration sentinel UPDATE users SET status=5 WHERE status IN (1) AND deleted_at IS NULL with audit comment. Document Status enum mapping clearly.

verdict: GREEN-LOCAL — API contract solid, 9 invariants verified, 0 P0 found. 4 backlog items for V1.0.2 (2 P1, 1 P2, 1 P3). NO frozen-zone touch, NO production code modified, NO push. Mobile-app surface gap is the load-bearing observation: there is NO livreur web UI in foodking-web — full E2E pickup/delivery user journey requires the React Native app.
